title: WEB-BOT-AUTH-1: Ultrastable's outbound agents sign their requests (Web Bot Auth) and publish the key directory
body:
**Owner:** Staff (platform)
**Trigger:** a signing key is bound to ultrastable-tick as a secret
**Done check:** grep:site/agentic.js::http-message-signatures-directory
**Status:** open

Cloudflare's agent-readiness scan checks /.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory (IETF Web Bot Auth). Ultrastable's own agents fetch other sites (scout, rnd profiles, outreach role-mailbox resolver); unsigned they look like any scraper and get blocked. Generate an Ed25519 key inside the Worker (stored sealed in D1 credentials, never printed), serve the public JWKS at the well-known path on ultrastable.io, and sign outbound fetches with Signature-Agent, Signature-Input and Signature headers. Closing probe: the directory answers 200 with a JWKS and a scout fetch carries a valid signature.
